name: New Paltz Venture Hub – Hot Spot

description.text: SUNY New Paltz, The State University of New York, is a four-year, public liberal arts college located in the Hudson Valley region.

targetApplicants.text: The Hudson Valley Venture Hub is the region’s Innovation Hot Spot, connecting entrepreneurs, startups, investors, business leaders, educators, and economic development organizations to help build a stronger entrepreneurial ecosystem and create the next generation of high-growth companies and quality jobs.

sources.quote: SUNY New Paltz | The State University of New York at New Paltz Toggle navigation Resources Tax Credit Instructions & Forms Accessing Students & Faculty Funding Resources HV Ecosystem Programs & Resources Submit Your Founder Need Or Opportunity Accelerator Ecosystem News The Hudson Valley Innovation Hot Spot For The Ecosystem For Start Ups Building the Next Generation of Hudson Valley Companies The Hudson Valley Venture Hub is the region’s Innovation Hot Spot, connecting entrepreneurs, startups, investors, business leaders, educators, and economic development organizations to help build a stronger entrepreneurial ecosystem and create the next generation of high-growth companies and quality jobs. Based at SUNY New Paltz, the Venture Hub serves entrepreneurs and businesses across the seven-county Mid-Hudson region: Dutchess, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Sullivan, Ulster, and Westchester counties. We help entrepreneurs find the right resources, relationships, expertise, and opportunities to move their businesses forward—from early growth and customer development to commercialization, fundraising, and scale. WHAT THE HV VENTURE HUB DOES The Venture Hub has two interconnected roles: strengthening the regional entrepreneurial ecosystem and directly supporting promising companies.
